svg.text: Solid lines: checked button circuit. Dashed red: internal power proposal, not yet selected.
Power: use a separate converter, not the PIR 3.3 V rail
Feed to 3V3 is conditional on the
Converter GND joins the common GND below. No concurrent USB/external power is assumed.
B / C / E are electrical terminals, not a drawing of the owned transistor’s lead order.
Follow the actual part’s pinout. No holes, package orientation or enclosure fit are specified here.
1 Identify E/B/C. 2 Solder both resistors at the base. 3 Wire common GND and collector.
4 Insulate the underside and add cable strain relief. 5 Add the qualified power module later.
Power disconnected while soldering. Keep S1 fitted. Leave the ESP antenna clear of copper, wiring and metal.
